notes.title: Spirit Fighters v1 Released!
notes.content:
Don't forget to report any bugs at zarioside@gmail.com !

Non Xbox controller users :
You might be able to change some or all control buttons within the game settings but it is not recommended. 
The reason for this is that they are not guaranteed to work with menu navigation.
Use a third party Xbox controller emulator like "x360ce" instead ( x360ce.com ).
